verdict.rationale: Cekura ships a CLI, SDK, and MCP/skills plugin, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents one. PII redaction and metric sampling are adjacent data-handling and cost controls, not opt-outs of the product's own telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
